# mori Corporate Contributor License Agreement (v1.0)

This Corporate Contributor License Agreement ("Agreement") is for contributors who are
contributing to **mori** as part of their work for an employer, or whose employer otherwise
owns the intellectual property in their contributions. It is adapted from the Apache Software
Foundation Corporate Contributor License Agreement, and it exists for the same reason as the
[Individual CLA](CLA.md): so that mori can remain **dual-licensed** (AGPL-3.0 + a commercial
licence — see [COMMERCIAL.md](../COMMERCIAL.md)).

> **In plain English:**
> - **Your company keeps ownership** of its contributions. This is a *licence*, not an assignment.
> - **Your company grants the project the right** to use, modify, distribute, **and sublicense**
>   those contributions — including **commercially** — which is what keeps mori's dual-licence
>   model possible.
> - **An authorised representative signs once** on behalf of the company, and lists the employees
>   designated to contribute (Schedule A).
> - **AI-assisted contributions are welcome**, on the same responsibility terms as the Individual CLA.
> - If an individual employee also contributes on their own behalf and time, they should additionally
>   sign the [Individual CLA](CLA.md).

You accept and agree to the following terms for Your present and future Contributions submitted
to the mori project. Except for the licence granted herein to the Project Owner and recipients of
software distributed by the Project Owner, You reserve all right, title, and interest in and to
Your Contributions.

## 1. Definitions

**"Project Owner"** means Frederick J. Wood (GitHub: `fjwood69`), the owner and maintainer of the
mori project, **and any successor entity** to which the mori project (or its relevant intellectual
property) is transferred or assigned — including, without limitation, any company subsequently
formed to hold the project. The licences and rights granted in this Agreement run to the Project
Owner and to such successors and assigns without any need for You to re-execute this Agreement.

**"You"** (or **"Your"**) means the corporation or other legal entity entering into this Agreement
with the Project Owner. For legal entities, the entity making a Contribution and all other entities
that control, are controlled by, or are under common control with that entity are considered to be a
single Contributor. For the purposes of this definition, **"control"** means (i) the power, direct or
indirect, to cause the direction or management of such entity, whether by contract or otherwise, or
(ii) ownership of fifty percent (50%) or more of the outstanding shares, or (iii) beneficial
ownership of such entity.

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any modifications or additions
to an existing work, that is intentionally submitted by You to the Project Owner for inclusion in,
or documentation of, any of the products owned or managed by the Project Owner (the **"Work"**),
where **"submitted"** has the same meaning as in the Individual CLA.

## 4. Representations

You represent that:

(a) You are legally entitled to grant the above licences, and that the persons designated in
Schedule A are authorised to submit Contributions on Your behalf.

(b) Each employee of Yours designated in Schedule A is authorised to submit Contributions on Your
behalf, and each Contribution is, to the best of Your knowledge, an original creation (see Section 7).

(c) **AI-assisted contributions.** Where any portion of a Contribution was generated with the
assistance of AI coding tools used under the direction of Your designated personnel, You represent
that You have the right to submit that Contribution, that it has been reviewed, and that You take
responsibility for it as Your own submission. The representations attach to You as the submitting
entity regardless of the tools used.

(d) Your Contribution submissions include complete details of any third-party licence or other
restriction (including, but not limited to, related patents and trademarks) of which You are aware

## 5. Support

You are not expected to provide support for Your Contributions, except to the extent You desire to
provide support. Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, You provide Your
Contributions on an **"AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND**, either express
or implied, including, without limitation, any warranties or conditions of TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT,
MERCHANTABILITY, or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

## 6. Notification

It is Your responsibility to notify the Project Owner when any change is required to the list of
designated employees authorised to submit Contributions on Your behalf, or to Your Point of Contact
with the Project Owner. You also agree to notify the Project Owner of any facts or circumstances of
which You become aware that would make these representations inaccurate in any respect.

## 7. Submissions on Behalf of Others

Should a Contribution include work that is not the original creation of You or Your designated
personnel, You may submit it to the Project Owner separately, identifying the complete details of its
source and of any licence or other restriction of which You are aware, and conspicuously marking the
work as **"Submitted on behalf of a third-party: [named here]."**
